name: leap_takeoff_light
for: hound pounce / wretch pounce take-off (fight.rs HOUND/WRETCH 'pounce')
notes: Dust kicked back off the ground (toward -x, behind a beast leaping +x): a rolling clot of dust and a low skid puff that drift back and thin, pebbles that fly back and settle, a spray of fine grit. Anchor = the hind feet on the ground. Built at the hound pounce sprite's density (107 px / 1.25 m); the wretch is about 79 px/m, so scale by px_per_m. Mirror x when leaping left. 10 frames @ 12 fps.
